name: Providing
overview: Scripture assures believers that God faithfully provides for their needs, promising that those who seek the Lord will not lack any good thing, including food and clothing. Jesus encourages His followers not to be anxious about daily necessities, emphasizing God's care in meeting these needs. The apostle Paul further affirms that God supplies all needs according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus, underscoring God's abundant provision for His people.
